The photograph opposite is the last of the series kindly given to us by our former President and founder-Editor Harry Hare. Six of the group were to become Presidents of Belgrave Harriers - H.
1, S.Frost (Thurrock) 12:16; 2, H.Evans (Thurrock) 12:26; 3, D.Sephton (GEC) 12:29; ... 14, N.Whorlow 13:25; 16, F.McManus 13:27; 20, P.Knight 13:38;34, P.Price 14:36;38, T.Pepper 15:53; 42 finished.
Congratulations were offered to Mr G F Piper and H Evans. The former may have been the Club’s earliest Olympian while the latter was an outstanding walking judge and committee member for many years.
